wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 03-003 wires the existing vanilla command-line parser at src/bootstrap/cmdline.ts into runDoomMain.  Both read-only refs (src/bootstrap/cmdline.ts and src/bootstrap/implement-vanilla-command-line-parsing.ts) are SHA-pinned by test/vanilla_parity/current-state/inventory-src-bootstrap-surface.test.ts:203 against the inventory-src-bootstrap-surface.json captured sha256 values; modifying either would break the plan_vanilla_parity 01-003 inventory test.  Wiring is therefore implemented as a new src/vanilla/commandLineConfiguration.ts that imports the CommandLine class without modifying the bootstrap surface, and runDoomMain calls parseCommandLineConfiguration on the validated argv.  The single-argument runDoomMain signature (Promise<void>) is preserved byte-stable from 03-001's pinned public surface; the typed CommandLineConfiguration is exported from the new wrapper module and consumed internally by runDoomMain.
publicSurface: CommandLineParseError extends Error (parameterName: string, receivedValue: string | null)
